source: Public official 2026-04-09 build: pursuing state, retarget selection, slot initialization. Independent implementation; original code/art not imported.

rules.clock: Subtract simulation dt only while pursuing; ordinary units return into attack before decrement inside effective attack range. Mounted ranged pursuit continues decrementing inside range.
rules.scan_gate: Timer <=0 AND cached pursuit-target squared distance >4*effective_range^2; strict boundary.
rules.empty_scan: Still resets to .15 when no better candidate exists.
rules.cost: Squared ground distance; ranged adds 1500 per current ranged claimant, including self on existing target.
rules.replacement: Strictly lower cost; equal cost keeps existing target. Explicit target orders are not immune.
rules.navigation: Target id may change during scan, but this movement step uses old cached target position and facing; next step uses new target. Mounted fire also cannot change the already cached navigation target in that step.
rules.holding: H, shield stance, attacks and ordinary moving do not run pursuit timer.

known_limits: No new same-condition original runtime retarget footage this turn; facts read from public legacy build, not latest Steam.
Project dictionaries use normal GDScript numbers; original timer stored in packed Float32 arrays. Exact float rounding/physics schedule equivalence not established.
Project deterministic random stream now also consumes one retarget phase draw per actor; this changes aggro phases and battle outcomes, not matched to original global RNG sequence.
Search iteration uses current project actor order, not original spatial hash order; ties among equally good new alternatives can differ.
Project terrain navigation, input/group extensions and full archetype/ability catalog remain incomplete relative to whole goal.
